title: Hear LP Giobbi’s Set From Dirtybird Campout x Northern Nights 2026
summary: An hour of house music straight from the woods of NorCal to you.
contentText:
The woods of Northern California served as the setting for a big old party when the second edition of Dirtybird Campout x Northern Nights happened this past July.

The fest happened among the towering redwoods at Cook’s Valley Campground, roughly 200 miles north of San Francisco, with a lineup including Clozee, Tape B, Walker & Royce b2b VNSSA, Hamdi, Justin Martin and LP Giobbi.

This latter artist is now presenting her complete set from the festival, which you can hear exclusively below. The hour-long set happened on the festival’s main stage, where the Oregon-born, Austin-based producer delivered loads of the rousing, textured and piano-injected house music that is her signature. Listen to the soaring performance below.

In addition to being a world-traveling DJ, LP Giobbi is also the co-founder of Femme House, an organization that works to create greater representation and inclusivity in the dance scene. For this work, she and her fellow Femme House co-founder Lauren Spalding appeared on Billboard ‘s 2026 list of Dance Power Players . LP’s upcoming performances include sets at We Belong Here Central Park in New York City, EDC Colombia and Creamfields Chile

Meanwhile, Dirtybird Campout x Northern Nights found its two titular indie festivals merging for the new hybrid event, which brought together the longstanding NorCal festival Northern Nights and Dirtybird Campout, which originally launched in 2015 as an offshoot of the Dirtybird label, the electronic imprint that was founded by producer Claude VonStroke in 2005 and acquired by indie label, distributor and publisher EMPIRE in 2022.
